playbook.intent: This week's tickets and call transcripts introduced words the project glossary has never defined, and at least one of them is being used by two people to mean two different things. The pass closes when every new term has a written definition on the single canonical page and each clash has been settled into one agreed reading.
playbook.scope: Project glossary stays canonical: new terms from this week's tickets and transcripts are defined; conflicting definitions are reconciled in one page.

success-criteria.criterion: Every domain term that surfaced in this week's tickets or transcripts and was missing from the glossary now carries a definition someone outside the project could read
Where two readings of the same term were in circulation, one survives on the page and the rejected reading is recorded together with why it lost
The glossary is genuinely one page: no competing copy lives on in a ticket comment, a spec appendix or a private notes file
Each definition names the person who confirmed it, so a term disputed later has someone to go back to
Terms that came up this week but could not be settled are listed openly as unresolved rather than quietly dropped
